name: System Hosts File Modification
description: Detects alteration or addition of entries in the operating system hosts resolution file.
explanation: Adversaries modify the hosts file to redirect legitimate security updates or banking domains to malicious IP addresses.
investigation_steps: Review the diff in hosts file content to see added host mappings.
Check active process list for processes that had write handles to the file.
Flush local DNS cache and verify integrity of DNS settings.
